import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(file_path="data.csv", columns=["A", "B", "C"]):
    if columns is None:
        columns = []
    else:
        columns = list(columns)

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    except pd.errors.EmptyDataError:
        df = pd.DataFrame()

    missing = [col for col in columns if col not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing columns in CSV: {missing}")

    df = df.copy()

    # Convert any already-numeric columns in the full DataFrame to float.
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            df[col] = df[col].astype(float)

    # Convert the specified columns to floats for plotting and cube-root computation.
    if columns:
        selected = df.loc[:, columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").astype(float)
        for col in columns:
            df[col] = selected[col]
    else:
        selected = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    # Draw the line chart.
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if not selected.empty:
        selected.plot(kind="line", ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.grid(True)

    # Compute cube-root values as a single Series.
    stacked = selected.stack(dropna=False)
    cube_root_series = pd.Series(
        np.cbrt(stacked.to_numpy()),
        index=stacked.index,
        name="cube_root",
    )

    return df, ax, cube_root_series
